verdict.rationale: Swell documents a full headless storefront API path: build frontends in any framework backed by the Swell backend API with official Node/PHP SDKs, environment-scoped auth keys, custom models/fields, purchase links, and CLI tooling for apps/themes/storefronts (swell-docs-1,7,8,9,19,26,33). This is corroborated by a runtime probe confirming the official CLI installs and runs. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable schema (probe shows 404s) and independent third-party developer accounts building a fully custom storefront outside Swell's own docs.
